tools.name: search_directory
tools.title: Search 1325.AI directory
tools.description: Search the 1325.AI directory of verified Black-owned businesses in the United States. Filters by keyword, category, city, state, minimum star rating, and whether the business has a website. Supports radius search: pass latitude, longitude, and radius_miles to return businesses within that distance, sorted by distance. Results can also be sorted by rating or review count. Each result includes name, category, phone, full address, latitude/longitude, distance in miles, Google Maps and directions links, description, logo, banner image, website, verified status, average rating, review count, and a link to the business profile page on 1325.ai.

query.description: Keyword to match in business name or description.

category.description: Business category, e.g. 'restaurant', 'salon', 'retail'. Use list_categories if unsure.

state.description: State name or 2-letter code, e.g. 'GA' or 'Georgia'.

latitude.description: User's latitude for a near-me search. Must be paired with longitude.

longitude.description: User's longitude for a near-me search. Must be paired with latitude.

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles around latitude/longitude. Defaults to 25.

min_rating.description: Only return businesses with at least this average star rating (0-5).

has_website.description: If true, only return businesses that have a website on file.

sort.description: Result ordering. 'distance' requires latitude/longitude. Defaults to 'distance' for near-me searches, otherwise 'best_match'.

limit.description: Max results to return (1-20). Defaults to 10.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List 1325.AI business categories
tools.description: List the business categories present in the 1325.AI directory with the number of verified businesses in each. Useful for discovering valid category values to pass to search_directory. Counts can be scoped to one city or state.

city.description: Optional city to scope category counts to.

state.description: Optional state (name or 2-letter code) to scope counts to.

limit.description: Max categories to return (1-60). Defaults to 30.

tools.name: get_business
tools.title: Get 1325.AI business details
tools.description: Fetch the full public profile for one business in the 1325.AI directory by its id. Returns name, category, description, full address, latitude/longitude, Google Maps and directions links, website, logo, banner image, verified status, average rating, review count, and a link to the business profile page on 1325.ai. Business ids are returned by search_directory.

business_id.description: The UUID of the business (returned by search_directory).

tools.name: list_rewards
tools.title: List loyalty rewards
tools.description: Browse active loyalty rewards available on 1325.AI. Returns rewards sorted by lowest point cost. Optionally filter to one business.

business_id.description: Optional business id to filter to that business's rewards.

limit.description: Max rewards to return (1-50). Defaults to 20.

tools.name: get_my_points_balance
tools.title: Get my loyalty points
tools.description: Return the signed-in 1325.AI user's total loyalty points and per-business balances. Requires the caller to be signed in.

tools.name: get_my_recent_scans
tools.title: Get my recent QR scans
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's most recent 1325.AI QR code scans (business visits that earned points).

limit.description: Max scans to return (1-50). Defaults to 20.
